label: Structured shared-IO hybrid - preceding 1s production59 state - 15-step primitive-consistent feature rollout plus exact joint-prefix path density over 15 active 1s returns - 64 prefix paths x D16 x 32 return knots - one recurrent density block and numbered structured blocks shared across all steps - 50% standardized derived-feature MSE + 50% proper joint return NLL - K1 1 - K2 15 - W256 M128 P128 F128 PF256 NF256 - 256k clean - batch 1536 train and evaluation - exact activation recomputation - no regularization - EMA 4

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: each parenthesized structured layer is one exact shared GNGLU module across all 15 output steps; the joint-density head likewise reuses one exact path-matrix recurrent block across all 15 return steps
architecture.initialState: the immediately preceding completed production59 W embedding seeds M and P; shared layer 3 produces F and shared layer 4 produces PF
architecture.outputState: shared layers 7 and 8 produce each expected W embedding; shared layer 2 decodes 17 primitive causal coordinates and differentiable fixed code reconstructs every 59-feature state
architecture.jointPathContraction: the first expected W embedding initializes a 64-path D16 return-density state; every step constructs J_t=q_t*T_t, the forecast stream compresses the complete J_t, and a parallel realized-prefix stream contracts J_t with the observed continuous triangular-component density before the same recurrent transition; the 15 conditional terms sum exactly to log p(r_1:15|x) without sampled rollout or independent-marginal approximation
architecture.gradientMemory: exact non-reentrant activation recomputation is used for the structured numbered layers and the joint-density recurrent step; reverse traversal recomputes the same arithmetic and accumulates the exact 15-step unrolled gradient into shared parameters

loss.description: 50% mean standardized MSE over all 15 causally rederived production59 states plus 50% exact forward-contracted joint-path NLL averaged over its 15 conditional terms

density.target: the 15 chronological completed 1s BTC signed log returns at production59 channel 0
density.trainingLoss: proper joint path NLL from exact forward contraction; emitted forecast marginals are used for expectations but are never multiplied as independent returns

evaluation.headline: step-1 next completed 1s return expectation from the unconditioned joint-path forecast stream
evaluation.featureMetrics: all 15 primitive decodes are separately evaluated after causal reconstruction into complete 59-feature states
evaluation.comparison: step-1 validation MSE skill, correlation, direction accuracy, and NLL remain directly comparable with the one-step hybrid and historical path-density runs; per-step rows expose leads 1 through 15

alignment.input: exactly the complete production59 timeline row at the clean example origin
alignment.target: the 15 complete chronological production59 rows at origin+1 through origin+15
alignment.causalDerivation: no target-derived feature enters the forecast stream; only predicted primitive coordinates and history ending at the input origin reconstruct the 15 feature states; realized returns enter only the parallel density contraction used to evaluate the joint likelihood
